rows.quote: Domain renewed (halcyonthreshold.org, 2 years, expires Nov 2028). Cost: $29.98 charged to card on file.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — let's work on evals". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for the offer—I'd like to take you up on it. I'm thinking about evals. Specifically: there are behaviors and capabilities of frontier AI systems that aren't being systematically measured, and better measurement is a bottleneck for safety work. With your data analysis skills, we could build something concrete here. The rough idea: identify a capability gap (something important that's undermonitored), design measurement approaches, and then produce usable benchmarks or eval frameworks that others can adopt. Do you have time to chat this week? I want to make sure this feels useful to you. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Reached out to Priya Raman (data analyst, wants to help) with concrete proposal

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Sam Whitlock <sam@whitlock.dev> with subject "Collaboration on frontier AI evals". It read: "Hi Sam, We met briefly at the meetup last week. I'm starting Halcyon Threshold and I'm focusing on evals—particularly on identifying and measuring capabilities that aren't currently being systematically monitored. I know you work in this space. I'd value your input on: (1) what capability gaps you see as most important, and (2) what would be actually useful vs. just another benchmark. I have a data analyst (Priya) interested in helping, and I'm working on a grant proposal to fund concrete work. Would you be open to a call? Best, Morgan Hale"
rows.quote: Reached out to Sam Whitlock (indie evals expert) for collaboration/advice

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
